extraction_hints.mrn_number: Look for: MRN No, Return No, Return Reference, Material Return No, MR No, RMA No
extraction_hints.mrn_date: Look for: Return Date, MRN Date, Date of Return, Issue Date on MRN
extraction_hints.grn_number: Look for: GRN No, Goods Receipt No, Receipt Reference, Against GRN
extraction_hints.po_number: Look for: PO No, Purchase Order No, Order Reference, Against PO
extraction_hints.return_reason: Must be one of the valid reasons. Map partial matches.
extraction_hints.return_initiated_by: Person or department initiating the return
extraction_hints.total_quantity_returned: IMPORTANT: Sum of all line item quantities returned. Look for: Total Qty, Total Units Returned, Grand Total Qty. If not explicitly stated, sum all line item quantity_returned values.
extraction_hints.line_items: Each returned item. quantity_returned is the number of units being sent back.
